name: Tool Share
idea: Neighbours own many tools they rarely use, while others buy the same tools for a single job. A small web app where members of one neighbourhood list tools they are willing to lend, browse what is available nearby, request a loan and track who has what, so fewer tools are bought and borrowed tools come back.
targetUsers: Residents of one neighbourhood or apartment building; a volunteer organiser who invites members.
market: Local community groups. Starting with one neighbourhood of 50-200 households.
research: Our residents' WhatsApp group gets about 10 'does anyone have a ...' messages a week. Loans are tracked nowhere, and two drills have gone missing this year. Members asked for something simpler than a spreadsheet.
businessModel: Free for members. Running costs should stay under 10 USD per month; later possibly a small donation link.
constraints: Must work well on phones. Keep personal data to a minimum (name, email, neighbourhood). No payments in the MVP.
